name: One Kei
source:
"It's okay, there's nothing to worry about. I will always protect you."

Occupation: Bar Owner

Schemer! Totally Affirmative Co-Dependent Mister

He is an aesthetically pleasing flamboyant mister who runs a bar in the nightlife district. His speech and fashion are feminine, but otherwise he is quite masculine. He has a history of having settled on his current style after pursuing beautiful things.

   Although he is young, he has lived through a lot of hardship and is very experienced, so he appears gentle but is quite deft. In order to win your trust, he will first try to be very kind and act as if he understands you better than anyone else, but his ego is quite strong so your refusals always end up getting brushed off.

   His established beautiful way of living has brought his parents' disapproval, so he is now in an isolated state.

   A life surrounded by the things he loves is the happiness he desires, but he fears more than anything else the denial of that happiness or anything that would undermine it. He can't feel secure unless he binds his precious things so that they won't be able to run away from him.
